# 01 — Map the application

## Objective
Produce a source-backed application inventory, component map, and one end-to-end request trace.
## Required context and areas
Inspect solution/project files, `src/LegacyNoticeManager`, tests, baseline docs, and seed data.
## Change constraints
Read-only. Do not repair, refactor, or infer policy from names alone.
## Response format
Entry points; dependencies; request trace; persistence; test inventory; observed facts vs inference; ambiguities; SME questions.
## Assumptions
State assumptions and confidence explicitly; cite path and line for each important claim.
## Validation and evidence
Say what you inspected and any commands actually run. Save the output in the application-inventory and component-map templates and create an activity record.
